acceptance_criteria.description: Build exactly two independent versioned Choice and Noul questions over shared untrusted state containing the validated LLM1 thesis, evidence, and a versioned necessary-precondition set.
Validate response envelope, answer IDs and primitive types, Choice options/distribution/confidence, and Noul probability without a fabricated Noul confidence.
Skip inference for LLM1 no_action and persist the deterministic reason.
Use only the documented HTTPS Decisions endpoint, bounded timeout/retry and fail-closed parsing without persisting credentials/raw error bodies.
Persist full sanitized request state/questions, typed answers, provenance, usage, failures, and upstream cycle/context/LLM1 correlation.
Use versioned, explicitly uncalibrated PAPER abstention thresholds without risk or order authority.
Enforce fixed question/vocabulary, session, request body/depth, timeout, and application request-spacing bounds; clearly distinguish provider limits that are undocumented.
Record authoritative endpoint/model/response documentation and distinguish it from live qualification.
